items.question: Where do I manage multiple companies?
items.description: Open the **Companies** screen to create, switch between, rename, or delete companies. Each company has its own completely separate data — invoices, customers, products, settings, and backups never mix.

items.question: How do I add a new company?
items.description: Click **+ New Company** on the Companies screen, enter a name and an admin username/password for it, then sign in to set it up.

items.question: How do I switch to a different company?
items.description: Click **Switch** next to a company on the Companies screen, or tap the company name at the top of the main sidebar. You'll be logged out and returned to the Login screen to sign in to the company you switched to.

items.question: How do I rename a company?
items.description: Click the pencil (edit) icon next to a company on the Companies screen and enter a new name.

items.question: How do I delete a company?
items.description: Click the trash icon next to a company on the Companies screen and type its name to confirm. This permanently deletes that company's data and cannot be undone — you can't delete the only remaining company.

items.question: How do I tell which company is currently active?
items.description: The currently loaded company is highlighted with a green **Active** badge on the Companies screen.

items.question: What is the company name shown in the sidebar?
items.description: It's the currently active company. Tap it to switch companies or open **Manage Companies**.

items.question: Where do I find company info settings?
items.description: Open the **Company Info** screen to set up your business profile, logo, and payment details.

items.question: Where do I manage my team?
items.description: Open **Team management** — only available on the Cloud edition, for inviting and managing teammates.

items.question: Where is the backup option?
items.description: Open the **Backup** screen to create, restore, or manage your data backups.

items.question: Where do I manage users?
items.description: Open **User Management**, where admins can add users and manage roles.

items.question: Where are PDF settings?
items.description: Open **PDF Settings** to choose your invoice template, page size, and theme color.

items.question: Where are invoice settings?
items.description: Open **Invoice Settings** to control invoice numbering, tax rules, branding, and which columns print.

items.question: Where do I set which product fields show?
items.description: Opens **Product Columns** settings, where you choose which product fields appear on forms and lists.

items.question: Where do I customize the app?
items.description: Opens the **Customize** screen, where you can request paid customizations like custom PDF templates or white-labeling.

items.question: Where are accessibility options?
items.description: Opens **Accessibility** settings — switch invoice layouts and view keyboard shortcuts.

items.question: Where do I check the app version?
items.description: Opens **Software Info**, showing your current app version and update status.

items.question: How do I check for app updates?
items.description: Checks right now whether a **newer version** of the app is available, instead of waiting for the automatic check.

items.question: How do I change the invoice number prefix?
items.description: Use this to add your own text before the invoice number, like **INV-** or **2026-**, so numbers read as INV-00001.

items.question: How do I set the starting invoice number?
items.description:
Use this to set the number your **first invoice** starts from.

This field **locks** once you've created at least one invoice, so decide it early.

items.question: How do I pad invoice numbers with leading zeros?
items.description: Pads invoice numbers with zeros so they're all the same length, e.g. **00000007** instead of 7.

items.question: How do I change the invoice currency?
items.description: Search for and select the **currency** used across your invoices, like INR, USD, or EUR.

items.question: How do I change the date format on invoices?
items.description: Use this to choose how dates are written on your invoices, e.g. **DD/MM/YYYY** or **MM/DD/YYYY**.

items.question: How do I switch between 12-hour and 24-hour time?
items.description: Use this to switch invoice times between **12-hour** (2:30 PM) and **24-hour** (14:30) format.

items.question: How do I show the invoice creation time on the PDF?
items.description: Prints your exact **time** the invoice was created, right next to the date on the PDF.

items.question: How do I rename the quantity column header?
items.description: Renames the **Qty** column header to something that fits your business, like **Hours** or **Units**.

items.question: How do I add extra notes to my invoices?
items.description: Use this free-text box for extra information you want printed on every invoice, like terms or delivery notes.

items.question: How do I add a thank you note to invoices?
items.description: Add a short thank-you message that prints at the bottom of every invoice, like **"Thank you for your business!"**

items.question: How do I hide the invoice number field by default?
items.description: Hide the **invoice number** field by default when you start a new invoice — you can still turn it back on per invoice.

items.question: How do I set a default tax rate?
items.description: Use this to set the **tax percentage** (like 18%) that's pre-filled on every new invoice, so you don't type it each time.

items.question: How do I turn tax on by default?
items.description: Use this to switch the **tax toggle** on by default so new invoices already have tax applied, instead of you enabling it every time.

items.question: How do I apply tax per item instead of globally?
items.description: Use this to choose whether tax uses **one rate for the whole invoice**, or a **different rate per item**.

items.question: How do I show GSTIN and HSN fields?
items.description: Use this to see **GSTIN** and **HSN** fields throughout the app — on invoices, PDFs, and exports — for GST-compliant billing.

items.question: How do I change the invoice title to Tax Invoice or Bill of Supply?
items.description: Pre-selects the title printed at the top of new invoices, such as **Tax Invoice**, **Bill of Supply**, or **Credit Note**.

items.question: How do I show rounded total and amount in words?
items.description: Use this to add a **rounded total** and write the amount in words (e.g. "Rupees One Thousand Only") on the PDF.

items.question: How do I print a product's local language name instead of English?
items.description: Prints the product's **local-language name** (its alias) on the PDF instead of its English name.

items.question: How do I allow decimal quantities like 1.5?
items.description: Lets you enter **decimal quantities** on invoice lines, like **1.5 hrs** or **2.25 kg**, instead of only whole numbers.

items.question: How do I show or hide the Product/Service tag on line items?
items.description: Use this to show or hide the small **Product**/**Service** label next to each invoice line item.

items.question: How do I add the same product twice to one invoice?
items.description: Lets you add the **same product twice** to one invoice — handy for different batches or rates.

items.question: How do I show previous balance due on an invoice?
items.description: Prints the customer's **previous outstanding balance** on the invoice PDF, on top of the current total.

items.question: How do I move the company logo left or right?
items.description: Moves your company logo to the **left** or **right** side of the invoice PDF.

items.question: How do I change the logo size on the PDF?
items.description: Use this to change how **big** your company logo prints on the invoice PDF.

items.question: How do I add a signature to my invoices?
items.description: Uploads an **authorized signature** image to print on your invoices, so they look officially signed.

items.question: How do I remove my signature from invoices?
items.description: Use this to remove the signature image you previously uploaded.

items.question: How do I resize the signature image?
items.description: Use this to change how **big** the signature image prints on the invoice PDF.

items.question: How do I move the signature left or right?
items.description: Moves the signature to the **left** or **right** side of the invoice PDF.

items.question: How do I add a watermark to my invoices?
items.description: Uploads a **watermark image** (like your logo or "PAID") to show faintly behind the invoice content.

items.question: How do I remove the watermark?
items.description: Use this to remove the watermark image you previously uploaded.

items.question: How do I make the watermark lighter or darker?
items.description: Use the slider to make the watermark more **faint** or more **visible** on the PDF.

items.question: How do I put the watermark on the full page instead of just the items table?
items.description: Use this to choose whether the watermark covers just the **items table**, or the **entire page**.

items.question: How do I show a serial number column on invoices?
items.description: Use this to add a **serial number** (1, 2, 3...) column to the items table on A4/Letter invoices.

items.question: How do I print product description on the invoice?
items.description: Prints each item's **description** in small text right under its name on A4 PDFs.

items.question: How do I print description on its own line?
items.description: Prints your item description as its **own full-width row**, instead of squeezed under the item name.

items.question: How do I show the HSN/SAC column?
items.description: Use this to add an **HSN/SAC code** column to the items table. Requires **Show GST Fields** to be turned on first.

items.question: How do I hide the quantity column for service billing?
items.description: Hide the **Quantity** column for service-only billing — the Price column is relabeled **Rate** instead.

items.question: How do I show CGST/SGST/IGST percentage per item?
items.description: Use this to add a column showing the **CGST/SGST/IGST** tax percentage for each item.

items.question: How do I show a discount column on invoices?
items.description: Use this to show or hide the per-item **discount** column in the invoice table.

items.question: How do I show storage, batch, or container number columns on the PDF?
items.description: Turn this on to add extra columns — like **storage location**, **batch**, or **container number** — on Grid Classic PDFs.

items.question: How do I enable custom fields on invoices?
items.description: Turn this on to add a **Custom Fields** section on the invoice-creation screen, so you can add fields specific to your business.

items.question: How do I add a custom field like vehicle number?
items.description: Use this to add a new custom field you can fill in per invoice, like **Vehicle No** or **PO Number**.

items.question: How do I rename or reorder a custom field?
items.description: Rename a custom field, reorder it, or delete it entirely.

items.question: How do I preview custom fields on the PDF?
items.description: Use this to see a full-size example of how your custom fields will look printed on the PDF.

items.question: How do I show the customer's business name on invoices?
items.description: Prints the customer's **business name** underneath their personal name on the invoice.

items.question: How do I show the customer's address on invoices?
items.description: Prints the customer's **address** in the "Bill To" section of the invoice.

items.question: How do I show the customer's phone number on invoices?
items.description: Prints the customer's **phone number** on the invoice.

items.question: How do I show the customer's email on invoices?
items.description: Prints the customer's **email address** on the invoice. Not shown on thermal receipts.

items.question: How do I show the customer's GSTIN on invoices?
items.description: Prints the customer's **GSTIN**/tax ID on the invoice. Requires **Show GST Fields** to be turned on first.

items.question: How do I change the PDF page size?
items.description: Use this to choose the paper size for your PDFs, like **A4** or **Letter**.

items.question: How do I change the invoice PDF template?
items.description: Picks the overall **look and layout** of your invoice and quotation PDFs.

items.question: How do I reset PDF settings to default?
items.description: Resets your **template**, page size, and colors back to the original defaults. This can't be undone.

items.question: How do I save PDF settings?
items.description: Saves the PDF settings you're currently previewing.

items.question: How do I switch PDF to landscape or portrait?
items.description: Use this to switch the page between **Portrait** and **Landscape** for the Grid Classic template.

items.question: How do I show a total quantity row on the PDF?
items.description: Use this to add a row at the bottom of the items table showing the **total quantity** across all lines.

items.question: How do I change the thermal receipt item layout?
items.description: Use this to choose how items are laid out on **thermal printer receipts**.

items.question: How do I change the company name text size on thermal receipts?
items.description: Use this to change how **big** your company name prints at the top of thermal receipts.

items.question: How do I change the PDF theme color?
items.description: Quickly pick one of **five preset colors** for your PDF theme.

items.question: How do I set a custom hex color for my PDF?
items.description: Type in your own **hex color code** (like #1565C0) to use as the PDF theme color.

items.question: How do I pick a PDF color visually?
items.description: Opens a **color wheel** so you can visually pick the exact PDF theme color.

items.question: How do I go back to the template's default color?
items.description: Clear any custom color and go back to the template's **original color**.

items.question: Is the product name field required?
items.description: The **product name** field is always shown and required — it can't be turned off.

items.question: Is the product price field required?
items.description: The **price** field is always shown and required — it can't be turned off.

items.question: How do I enable stock tracking for products?
items.description: Turn this on to enable **stock tracking** for products, adding a stock quantity field to forms and lists.

items.question: How do I add a local language product name?
items.description: Use this to add a **local-language name** field to products, useful for printing names in another language.

items.question: How do I set a tax rate per product?
items.description: Use this to add a **per-product tax rate** field, so each product can have its own tax percentage.

items.question: How do I add HSN/SAC to a product?
items.description: Use this to add an **HSN or SAC code** field to products.

items.question: How do I add a description field to products?
items.description: Use this to add a free-text **description** field to products.

items.question: How do I track purchase price / cost price?
items.description: Use this to add a **purchase price** (cost) field to products, so you can track your profit margin.

items.question: How do I set a default discount on a product?
items.description: Use this to add a **default discount** field that pre-fills whenever this product is added to an invoice.

items.question: How do I add a unit field like pcs or kg to products?
items.description: Use this to add a **unit of measure** field to products, like **pcs**, **kg**, or **hrs**.

items.question: How do I mark a product as a service?
items.description: Use this to add a selector to mark each item as a **Product** or a **Service**.

items.question: How do I enable extra product metadata fields?
items.description: Turn this on to reveal the whole group of extra product fields — storage, batch, expiry, and more — so you can enable them individually.

items.question: How do I add storage location to products?
items.description: Use this to add a **storage location** field to products, e.g. "Warehouse A, Shelf 3".

items.question: How do I add container number to products?
items.description: Use this to add a **container number** field to products.

items.question: How do I add batch number to products?
items.description: Use this to add a **batch number** field to products, useful for tracking manufacturing batches.

items.question: How do I add expiry date to products?
items.description: Use this to add an **expiry date** field to products.

items.question: How do I add manufacture date to products?
items.description: Use this to add a **manufacture date** field to products.

items.question: How do I add manufacturer name to products?
items.description: Use this to add a **manufacturer name** field to products.

items.question: How do I add supplier name to products?
items.description: Use this to add a **supplier name** field to products.

items.question: How do I add a SKU code to products?
items.description: Use this to add a **SKU code** field to products.

items.question: How do I add notes to products?
items.description: Use this to add a free-text **notes** field to products.

items.question: How do I add an extra charge to an invoice line?
items.description: Use this to add an optional **extra charge** field on invoice lines, for one-off fees like packaging or handling.

items.question: How do I add my company logo?
items.description: Tap the logo box and choose a **PNG or JPG** image to use as your company logo.

items.question: How do I remove my company logo?
items.description: Use this to remove your saved company logo image.

items.question: How do I hide the logo from invoice PDFs?
items.description: Use this to show or hide your **logo** on generated invoice PDFs.

items.question: How do I change my company name?
items.description: Enter your business name; it is shown on every invoice.

items.question: How do I add my company's GSTIN?
items.description: Enter your company's **GSTIN**/VAT registration number. The field label changes based on your selected country.

items.question: How do I add my company's PAN or TIN?
items.description: Enter your company's **PAN or TIN** number. The field label depends on your selected country.

items.question: How do I add my FSSAI code?
items.description: Enter your **FSSAI** license code, for Indian food businesses only.

items.question: How do I change my company's country?
items.description: Search for and select your company's **country** from the dropdown.

items.question: How do I change my company phone number?
items.description: Enter your company's **phone number**, shown on invoices.

items.question: How do I change my company email?
items.description: Enter your company's **email address**, shown on invoices.

items.question: How do I add my website to invoices?
items.description: Your **website URL**, shown on invoices.

items.question: How do I change my company address?
items.description: Enter your company's **address**, shown on invoices.

items.question: How do I set my business as product, service, or both?
items.description: Marks your business as selling **Products**, **Services**, or **Both** — this changes which fields and reports you see.

items.question: How do I add a UPI QR code to my invoice?
items.description: Use this to add a scannable **UPI QR code** to your invoice PDFs, so customers can pay instantly by scanning it.

items.question: How do I add my UPI ID?
items.description: Enter your **UPI ID** (like yourname@bank), used to generate the payment QR code on invoices.

items.question: How do I set a default UPI account?
items.description: Use this to mark one **UPI account** as the default — the one shown when you have more than one.

items.question: How do I add another UPI account?
items.description: Use this to add a **new UPI account** row so you can accept payments to a different UPI ID alongside your existing ones.

items.question: How do I remove a UPI account?
items.description: Use this to remove a **UPI account** row.

items.question: How do I show bank details on my invoices?
items.description: Prints the **bank account details** on invoice PDFs, so customers can pay by bank transfer.

items.question: How do I add a bank account for invoice payments?
items.description: Use this to add a **new bank account** row for accepting payments.

items.question: How do I add an IFSC code?
items.description: Your bank branch's **IFSC code**, needed for bank transfers.

items.question: How do I add my IBAN?
items.description: For companies outside India, the IFSC field is automatically replaced by an **IBAN** field, based on the country set in Company Details. Enter it there — it prints on invoices in place of the IFSC code.

items.question: How do I set a default bank account?
items.description: Use this to mark one **bank account** as the default — the one shown when you have more than one.

items.question: How do I remove a bank account?
items.description: Use this to remove a **bank account** row.

items.question: How do I edit a bank account in a larger view?
items.description: Click the expand icon next to a bank account row to edit its Label, Bank Name, Account Number, and IFSC/IBAN in a larger dialog instead of the compact inline row.

items.question: How do I save my company info changes?
items.description:
Saves all your changes to company info, logo, and payment details.

Make sure to click this after editing — changes aren't saved automatically.

items.question: How do I create a new invoice, quotation, or receipt?
items.description: Open a new **Invoice**, **Quotation**, or **Receipt** form, ready to fill in.

items.question: How do I search for an invoice?
items.description: Type a **customer name** or **invoice ID** to instantly filter the list.

items.question: How do I clear the invoice search?
items.description: Clear your search text and show the full invoice list again.

items.question: How do I filter invoices by customer?
items.description: Use the picker to filter the list down to **one customer's** invoices.

items.question: How do I remove the customer filter?
items.description: Use this to remove the active customer filter and show all invoices again.

items.question: How do I filter invoices by payment status or date?
items.description: Use the dialog to filter invoices by **payment status**, **due date**, **date range**, or **invoice number range**.

items.question: How do I sort the invoice list?
items.description: Use the dialog to choose how the invoice list is **sorted** — by date, customer, and more.

items.question: How do I bulk download invoice PDFs by date or number range?
items.description: Use the dialog to **bulk-download** invoice PDFs filtered by a date range or invoice-number range — handy for grabbing a whole month at once.

items.question: How do I export all invoices to CSV?
items.description: Export **all your invoices** (or a chosen date range) to a **CSV file** you can open in Excel or Google Sheets.

items.question: How do I view deleted invoices?
items.description: Opens the **Trash**, listing deleted invoices you can restore or permanently remove.

items.question: How do I refresh the invoice list?
items.description: Reload the invoice list from the beginning, picking up any recent changes.

items.question: Where did the toolbar buttons go on a small screen?
items.description: On smaller screens, the download, export, trash, and refresh buttons collapse into one **3-dot menu**.

items.question: How do I confirm a CSV export?
items.description: Confirm the CSV export using the date range you picked, or **"export all"**.

items.question: How do I export every invoice instead of a date range?
items.description: Use this to switch the export from a specific date range to **every invoice** you have.

items.question: How do I switch between date range and invoice number range for bulk PDF download?
items.description: Use this to switch the bulk-download dialog between filtering **by date range** and filtering **by invoice number range**.

items.question: How do I preview how many invoices match before downloading?
items.description: Use this to see how many invoices match your filter **before** you download them, so there are no surprises.

items.question: What sort options are available for the invoice list?
items.description: The invoice list can be sorted by **ID**, **date**, or **customer name**, in either direction.

items.question: How do I change how many invoices show per page?
items.description: Choose how many invoices show on each page — **10, 25, 50, or 100**.

items.question: How do I go to the previous page of invoices?
items.description: Go back to the previous page of invoices.

items.question: How do I go to the next page of invoices?
items.description: Move forward to the next page of invoices.

items.question: How do I select all invoices on the page?
items.description: Select or deselect **every invoice** currently shown on the page.

items.question: How do I select one invoice for a bulk action?
items.description: Select one invoice to include in a **bulk action**, like bulk export or bulk delete.

items.question: How do I view an invoice's details?
items.description: Opens a **read-only preview** of the invoice's full details.

items.question: How do I edit an invoice?
items.description: Opens the invoice in the **edit form** so you can change its details.

items.question: How do I record a payment against an invoice?
items.description: Use the dialog to **record a payment** against an unpaid or partially-paid invoice.

items.question: How do I duplicate an invoice from the invoice list?
items.description: Use the dialog to **clone** this invoice as a brand-new Invoice or Quotation, with today's date and a fresh number.

items.question: How do I preview an invoice as a PDF?
items.description: Use this to see a **PDF preview** of the invoice without downloading it.

items.question: How do I download a single invoice as a PDF?
items.description: Download this invoice as a **PDF file** to your computer.

items.question: How do I print an invoice?
items.description: Send the invoice straight to your **printer**.

items.question: How do I delete an invoice?
items.description:
Moves the invoice to **Trash** — it disappears from your invoice list, but nothing is deleted for good.

You can restore it any time from the Trash dialog.

items.question: Where are the invoice row action buttons on a small screen?
items.description: On narrow screens, all the row action buttons collapse into a single **3-dot menu**.

items.question: How do I restore a deleted invoice?
items.description: Bring a deleted invoice back from **Trash** into your active invoice list.

items.question: How do I permanently delete an invoice?
items.description: **Permanently deletes** the invoice — this cannot be undone, so use it only for invoices you're certain you don't need.

items.question: How do I clear my invoice selection?
items.description: Clear every invoice you've currently selected.

items.question: How do I select every invoice on the current page?
items.description: Select every invoice on the **current page** in one click.

items.question: How do I mark multiple invoices as paid at once?
items.description: Marks all the **selected invoices** as fully paid in one action — handy for clearing a batch of settled invoices at once.

items.question: How do I export selected invoices to CSV?
items.description: Export just the **selected invoices** to a CSV file, instead of your whole list.

items.question: How do I download selected invoices as PDFs?
items.description: Downloads the **selected invoices** as PDFs, saved either as separate files in a folder or bundled into a ZIP.

items.question: How do I delete multiple invoices at once?
items.description: Moves all **selected invoices** to Trash at once. They're not deleted for good — you can restore them later.

items.question: How do I save exported PDFs to a folder?
items.description: Saves the exported PDFs as **separate files** in a folder you choose.

items.question: How do I download exported PDFs as a ZIP file?
items.description: Bundle all the exported PDFs into a single **ZIP file**, handy for emailing or archiving.

items.question: How do I clear all invoice filters?
items.description: Clear every filter field back to its default, inside the Filter dialog.

items.question: How do I apply invoice filters?
items.description: Apply your chosen filters and refresh the invoice list.

items.question: How do I hide fully paid invoices?
items.description: Hide invoices that have **no outstanding balance**, so you only see what still needs attention.

items.question: How do I filter invoices by paid, partial, or unpaid status?
items.description: Filters the list to show only **Paid**, **Partial**, or **Unpaid** invoices.

items.question: How do I find overdue or due-soon invoices?
items.description: Finds invoices that are **overdue** or **due soon**.

items.question: How do I filter invoices by a date range?
items.description: Use this to see only invoices dated within a **date range** you choose.

items.question: How do I filter invoices by invoice number range?
items.description: Use this to see only invoices whose **number** falls within a range you choose.

items.question: How do I change my dashboard layout?
items.description: Click the **grid icon** in the top-right corner of the dashboard, then pick **Default**, **Classic**, **Bento**, or **Simple Feed**.

items.question: What dashboard layouts are available?
items.description:
You can choose from four layouts:

**Default** — the original layout.

**Classic** — charts plus a KPI grid.

**Bento** — a large hero chart with a card grid.

**Simple Feed** — a clean, simple list view.

items.question: What reports are available?
items.description: You can view nine reports: **Revenue**, **Receivables**, **Tax**, **Customers**, **Products**, **Quotations**, **Invoice Status**, **Daily Report**, and **Inventory**.

items.question: How do I refresh a report?
items.description: Reload the data for the report you're currently viewing.

items.question: How do I see report data across all currencies?
items.description: Use this to switch between viewing data in just your **selected currency**, or across **all currencies** you've used.

items.question: How do I change the date range for a report?
items.description: Choose from these presets: **Last 30 days**, **Last 3/6 months**, **This year**, **This FY**, **Last FY** — or pick a fully custom range.

items.question: How do I export a report to CSV or PDF?
items.description: Every report has a **Save/Export** button to download it as a **CSV** or a formatted **PDF**.

items.question: How do I change rows per page in a report table?
items.description: Report tables have their own rows-per-page and page-navigation controls, separate from the main list.

items.question: Why does it say some items are missing cost data?
items.description:
It means some sold items don't have a **cost price** set, so their profit can't be calculated accurately.

Add a cost price to those products to fix it.

items.question: What do the Revenue report KPI cards show?
items.description: Six totals for the period: **Billed**, **Collected**, **Outstanding**, **Avg Invoice**, **Profit**, and **Realized Profit**.

items.question: How do I see my monthly revenue trend?
items.description: A bar chart showing **billed**, **collected**, and **profit** for each month.

items.question: How do I see a month-by-month revenue breakdown?
items.description: A table breaking revenue down **month by month** — invoices, billed, collected, outstanding, cost, profit, and margin.

items.question: How do I see how many invoices are paid, partial, or unpaid?
items.description: A donut chart showing how many invoices are **Paid**, **Partial**, or **Unpaid**.

items.question: How do I see accounts receivable aging by customer?
items.description: Use this to see each customer's outstanding balance, grouped by **how overdue** it is — current, 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, and 90+ days.

items.question: How do I see which invoices are overdue and by how many days?
items.description: A list of individual overdue invoices, each showing exactly **how many days overdue** it is.

items.question: How do I see total tax collected?
items.description: Use this to see the **total tax charged** on your invoices, and how many different tax rates were used, for the period.

items.question: How do I see a breakdown of tax by rate?
items.description: Breaks tax down **by rate** — taxable amount, tax collected, and gross amount for each rate you use.

items.question: How do I switch between top customers and customer statements?
items.description: Use this to switch between a **top-customers overview** and a **single customer's statement** view.

items.question: How do I see my top customers by revenue?
items.description: Rank your customers by how much they've paid you, with a bar chart and a full table.

items.question: How do I view a specific customer's statement?
items.description: Search for and select which **customer's statement** (ledger) you want to view.

items.question: How do I choose which currency shows in a customer statement?
items.description: If a customer has invoices in more than one currency, choose which one to show in their statement.

items.question: What does a customer statement show?
items.description: Use this to see a customer's **opening balance**, what they were invoiced, what they paid, their **closing balance**, and anything overdue — plus a full transaction-by-transaction ledger.

items.question: How do I rank products by profit instead of revenue?
items.description: Use this to switch the top-products ranking between **by revenue** and **by profit**.

items.question: How do I see my top-selling products?
items.description: Rank your best-selling products or services, showing units sold, discount given, and profit margin.

items.question: How do I see my quotation-to-invoice conversion rate?
items.description: Use this to see how many **quotations** you've sent, how many turned into **invoices**, and your overall **conversion rate**.

items.question: How do I filter invoice status by month?
items.description: Filters the list to the **last 30 days**, or a specific **month and year**.

items.question: How do I filter invoices by payment status in reports?
items.description: Chips to filter by **All**, **Paid**, **Partial**, **Unpaid**, or **Overdue**.

items.question: What do the Invoice Status KPI cards show?
items.description: Quick counts: **Total**, **Paid**, **Partial**, **Unpaid**, and **Overdue** invoices.

items.question: How do I see a list of all invoices with their payment status?
items.description: A full list of invoices with date, ID, customer, total, amount paid, outstanding, and status.

items.question: How do I see daily sales for a specific month?
items.description: Choose **Today**, **Last 30 days**, a specific **month and year**, or a **custom range** (up to 31 days).

items.question: How do I see day-by-day sales and profit?
items.description: A day-by-day table of sales, cost, profit, and margin.

items.question: How do I see which invoices made up a specific day's sales?
items.description: Click any day's row to jump straight to **Invoice Status**, filtered to just that day's invoices.

items.question: How do I see the total value of my current stock?
items.description: Use this to see the value of stock you're currently holding: **blocked value**, **potential sale value**, **locked profit**, total units, and products tracked.

items.question: Why are some products excluded from inventory valuation?
items.description: **Services** and products marked as **unlimited stock** aren't counted, since they don't represent physical inventory sitting on a shelf.

items.question: How do I see stock value per product?
items.description: A per-product table of stock quantity, purchase price, stock value, and potential sale value.

items.question: How do I add a new product or service?
items.description: Opens a slide-out form to add a new **product** or **service**.

items.question: How do I import products from a CSV file?
items.description: Opens the CSV import rules before letting you pick a file — check these first so your file matches what's expected.

items.question: How do I get a sample CSV template for importing products?
items.description: Downloads a **sample CSV file** showing exactly which columns to use, so your own import file matches.

items.question: How do I handle duplicate products when importing CSV?
items.description: When a row in your CSV matches an existing product by name, you choose whether to **overwrite** it or **skip** it — either one at a time, or all at once.

items.question: How do I export my product list to CSV?
items.description: Export your full product list, with metadata, to a **CSV file**.

items.question: How do I export my product list as a PDF?
items.description: Export your product list (current page or all) as a **PDF table**.

items.question: How do I delete all products at once?
items.description: **Admin only.** Deletes every product and service after you confirm — this cannot be undone.

items.question: How do I refresh the product list?
items.description: Reload the product list and stats from scratch.

items.question: How do I search for a product?
items.description: Type a name, alias, or **HSN/SAC code** to instantly filter products.

items.question: How do I filter products by stock status?
items.description: Filter by stock level: **All**, **Low stock**, **Out of stock**, or **Expired**.

items.question: How do I sort the product list?
items.description: Sort by **Name**, **Price**, or **Stock**, ascending or descending.

items.question: How do I customize which product fields exist?
items.description: Opens **Product Columns** settings, where you turn form/list fields on or off.

items.question: How do I choose which columns show in the product table?
items.description: Choose which of your enabled fields show as **columns** in the product table — up to 10 at once.

items.question: How do I hide the product stat cards?
items.description: Use this to show or hide the summary stat cards at the top of the screen.

items.question: How do I filter products by type or stock level?
items.description: Tabs to quickly filter by **All**, **Products**, **Services**, **Low Stock**, **Out of Stock**, or **Expired** (if expiry tracking is on).

items.question: How do I view a product's details?
items.description: Opens a read-only view of the product's full details.

items.question: How do I edit a product?
items.description: Opens the product's details in **edit mode**.

items.question: How do I delete a product?
items.description: **Admin only.** Deletes this product after you confirm.

items.question: How do I change rows per page in the product list?
items.description: Choose how many products show per page — **10, 25, 50, or 100** — and move between pages.

items.question: How do I add a service instead of a product?
items.description: Choose whether the new item is a **Product** or a **Service**.

items.question: How do I mark a product as having unlimited stock?
items.description: Marks the product as **unlimited stock**, so it's never tracked as running low or out.

items.question: How do I indicate the price already includes tax?
items.description: Tells the app the price you entered **already includes tax**, so it won't be added again.

items.question: How do I set a unit of measure for a product?
items.description: Pick a preset **unit** (like kg or pcs), or type your own.

items.question: How do I keep adding products quickly without closing the form?
items.description: Keep this box checked to keep the form open after saving, so you can **add several products in a row** without reopening it each time.

items.question: Why am I warned when saving a product?
items.description: You'll see this warning when the **purchase price is higher than the sale price** — it's a safety check to catch pricing mistakes before you save.

items.question: How do I add a new customer?
items.description: Opens a slide-out form to add a new customer.

items.question: How do I import customers from a CSV file?
items.description: Opens CSV import instructions before letting you pick a file.

items.question: How do I get a sample CSV template for importing customers?
items.description: Downloads a **sample CSV template** showing the expected columns.

items.question: How do I handle duplicate customers when importing CSV?
items.description: When a row matches an existing customer, choose to **overwrite** or **skip** it — one at a time, or all at once.

items.question: How do I export my customer list to CSV?
items.description: Export your currently filtered customer list to a **CSV file**.

items.question: How do I export my customer list as a PDF?
items.description: Export your filtered customer list as a **PDF table**.

items.question: How do I delete all customers at once?
items.description: **Admin only.** Deletes every customer after a typed confirmation — this cannot be undone.

items.question: How do I refresh the customer list?
items.description: Reload the customer list, balances, and currencies.

items.question: How do I search for a customer?
items.description: Search by name, email, phone, business name, address, or tax number.

items.question: How do I filter customers by tax or GST registration?
items.description: Filter by **All**, **Tax/GST-registered**, or **Without tax** customers.

items.question: How do I switch which currency shows for outstanding balances?
items.description: Choose which currency the **outstanding balance** column and sort should reflect.

items.question: How do I sort the customer list?
items.description: Sort by **Name**, **ID**, or **Outstanding balance**, ascending or descending.

items.question: How do I choose which columns show in the customer table?
items.description: Show or hide the **Phone**, **Email**, **Tax/VAT**, **Address**, or **Outstanding** columns.

items.question: How do I hide the customer stat cards?
items.description: Use this to show or hide the four summary stat cards at the top.

items.question: How do I filter customers by type or outstanding balance?
items.description: Tabs to filter by **All**, **Businesses**, **Individuals**, **Tax/GST Registered**, **With Outstanding**, or **Without Tax**.

items.question: How do I view a customer's details?
items.description: Opens a read-only view of the customer's details.

items.question: How do I view a customer's statement?
items.description: Jumps to the **Reports** screen, opening straight to this customer's **statement** (their transaction ledger).

items.question: How do I receive payment for multiple invoices from one customer?
items.description:
Opens a payment dialog listing the customer's **open invoices**.

Type a total and click **Auto-allocate** to apply it smallest-balance-first, clearing as many invoices as possible. Or edit each invoice's amount yourself for full control.

Set the date, payment method, and any notes, then click **Apply Payment** to record it against all of them in one go.

items.question: How do I edit a customer?
items.description: Opens an editable dialog to update the customer's details.

items.question: How do I delete a customer?
items.description: **Admin only.** Deletes this customer after you confirm.

items.question: How do I change rows per page in the customer list?
items.description: Choose how many customers show per page — **10, 25, 50, or 100** — and move between pages.

items.question: How do I keep adding customers quickly without closing the form?
items.description: Keep this box checked to keep the New Customer form open after saving, so you can **add several customers in a row**.

items.question: How do I create a database backup?
items.description: Creates a full **database backup file** — everything in one file you can restore from later.

items.question: How do I export my data as a JSON backup?
items.description: Creates a **JSON export** of your data, useful if you need it in a readable, portable format.

items.question: How do I import a backup file?
items.description:
Opens a file picker to import a backup file.

Once the import finishes, the **app restarts automatically** to load the restored data.

items.question: How do I restore a backup?
items.description:
Restores the backup you selected.

**The app restarts afterward** — save any other work first.

items.question: How do I download a backup file?
items.description: Saves the backup file to your **Downloads folder**.

items.question: How do I share a backup file?
items.description: Opens the share menu so you can send the backup file elsewhere — email, cloud storage, and so on.

items.question: How do I delete an old backup?
items.description: Deletes the selected backup file after you confirm. This **cannot be undone**.

items.question: How do I refresh the backup list?
items.description: Reload the list of backups you have saved.

items.question: Are backups separate for each company?
items.description: Yes. Each company's backups are stored separately, so switching companies only shows that company's own backups. Backups made before multi-company support was added still show up under your original company.

items.question: How do I get a custom PDF invoice template?
items.description: A **paid request** ($30-$50) for a custom-designed invoice PDF template made just for your business.

items.question: How do I get custom fields added to my invoices?
items.description: A **paid request** ($25-$100) to have bespoke fields added to your invoices.

items.question: How do I get a white-label branded version of the app?
items.description: A **paid request** ($100-$150) for a **white-label** version of the app, rebranded with your own name and logo.

items.question: How do I get a custom build for my industry?
items.description: A **paid request** ($175-$200) for a version of the app tailored to your specific industry.

items.question: How do I switch between the new and classic create-invoice layout?
items.description: A toggle between the **New** and **Classic** layout for the create-invoice screen — pick whichever feels more comfortable.

items.question: What keyboard shortcuts are available?
items.description: Lists every available **keyboard shortcut**. Only shown on **desktop** — not available on Android.

items.question: What is the default login username and password?
items.description: First-time setup uses username **admin** and password **admin**; you'll be asked to set a new password on first login.

items.question: How do I add a new user?
items.description: Opens a slide-out form to create a new user with a **username**, **password**, and **role**.

items.question: How do I search for a user?
items.description: Filters the list live as you type a **username** or **role**.

items.question: How do I filter users by role?
items.description: Filter by **All roles**, **Admin**, or **User**.

items.question: How do I view a user's details?
items.description: Opens a read-only view showing the user's **username** and **role**.

items.question: How do I edit a user?
items.description: Opens the slide-out form pre-filled to edit the user's **username** or **role**.

items.question: How do I reset another user's password?
items.description:
Use the dialog to reset another user's password.

You'll need to enter **your own current password**, plus their new one.

items.question: How do I delete a user?
items.description: Deletes this user after you confirm. You **can't delete your own account** this way.

items.question: How do I delete multiple users at once?
items.description: Deletes all the checked users at once after you confirm. Your own account is **automatically skipped** if selected.

items.question: How do I make a user an admin?
items.description: A dropdown to set a user's role to **Admin** or **User** when adding or editing them.

items.question: Why can't I change my own role or demote the last admin?
items.description: Two safety rules: you **can't change your own role**, and you can't demote the **last remaining admin** — there always needs to be at least one.

items.question: How do I change my own password?
items.description: Non-admin users can update their own **username** and **password** from a simplified My Account view.

items.question: What do the dashboard stat cards show?
items.description: Five totals: **Customers**, **Products** (with an out-of-stock count), **Invoices**, **Revenue Collected**, and **Outstanding** balance.

items.question: How do I create a quotation or receipt instead of an invoice?
items.description: A dropdown to choose whether you're creating an **Invoice**, **Quotation**, or **Receipt**.

items.question: How do I set the invoice date or due date?
items.description: Date pickers for the **invoice date** and an optional **due date**.

items.question: How do I change this invoice's title to Tax Invoice or Bill of Supply?
items.description: Choose the title printed at the top of this invoice, like **Tax Invoice**, **Bill of Supply**, or **Credit Note**.

items.question: How do I hide the invoice number on this invoice's PDF?
items.description: Hide the auto-generated **invoice number** from this invoice's printed PDF.

items.question: How do I set my own invoice number instead of the auto number?
items.description: Type your own number to print instead of the auto-generated one.

items.question: How do I start a new invoice while editing another one?
items.description:
The **New Invoice** button (or **Ctrl+Q**) resets the form to start fresh.

If you have unsaved changes, you'll be asked to confirm first.

items.question: How do I add customer information to an invoice?
items.description: Fill in the customer's **name**, business name, **phone**, GSTIN/VAT, email, and address.

items.question: How do I select an existing customer for an invoice?
items.description: Opens a searchable list to pick an **existing customer** — their details fill in automatically.

items.question: How do I save a new customer while creating an invoice?
items.description: Saves the name and contact details you've entered as a **new or updated customer record**.

items.question: How do I edit a selected customer's details on this invoice?
items.description: Unlocks a selected customer's fields so you can edit them **just for this invoice**, without changing their saved record.

items.question: How do I refresh customer details to the latest saved version?
items.description: Pulls the customer's **latest saved details** back into the form, discarding any edits made on this invoice.

items.question: How do I remove the selected customer from an invoice?
items.description: Use this to remove the selected customer and clear all the customer fields.

items.question: What happens if I change a customer's phone number on an invoice?
items.description: If the phone number you enter matches — or changes to match — another saved customer, you'll be asked whether to **save as a new customer** or **update the existing one**.

items.question: How do I save a walk-in customer after creating their invoice?
items.description: After saving an invoice for someone not yet in your customer list, you'll be offered the chance to **add them as a customer**.

items.question: How do I add a product to an invoice?
items.description: Search your product list (press **Ctrl+F** to jump here) and pick a match from the dropdown.

items.question: How do I add an item that's not in my product list?
items.description: Press **Ctrl+M**, or click **Custom Item**, to add a line for something **not in your product catalog**.

items.question: What fields can I set when adding a line item?
items.description: Each line item can have its own **quantity**, unit, price, **discount** (flat or per-unit), extra cost, **tax rate**, description, and position in the list.

items.question: Can I add an item that's out of stock or low on stock?
items.description: Yes — a confirmation dialog lets you **add it anyway**, even beyond the tracked stock.

items.question: How do I edit a line item on an invoice?
items.description: Click the **pencil icon** on a line item to change its quantity, price, discount, or description.

items.question: How do I remove a line item from an invoice?
items.description: Click the **trash icon** on a line item to remove it from the invoice.

items.question: How do I save a custom item into my product list?
items.description: Click the **bookmark icon** on a custom line item to save it permanently to your **product catalog**.

items.question: How do I turn tax on or off for an invoice?
items.description: Turns **tax calculation** on or off for the entire invoice.

items.question: How do I apply tax per item instead of one rate for the whole invoice?
items.description: Choose **Global** (one tax rate for the whole invoice) or **Per-item** (each item has its own rate).

items.question: How do I switch to IGST for an interstate sale?
items.description: Use this to switch GST calculation from **CGST/SGST** to **IGST**, for sales across state lines.

items.question: How do I apply a discount to the whole invoice?
items.description: Apply an overall discount to the invoice, as either a **percentage** or a **fixed amount**.

items.question: How do I add an extra charge or deduction to an invoice?
items.description: Add named rows for extra fees (like shipping) or deductions — enter a **negative amount** for a deduction.

items.question: How do I choose which UPI account shows on an invoice?
items.description: Choose which saved **UPI account** prints on this invoice's QR code.

items.question: How do I choose which bank account shows on an invoice?
items.description: Choose which saved **bank account** prints on this invoice for bank transfers.

items.question: How do I add a note to an invoice?
items.description: A free-text note printed on the invoice — click the expand icon for a bigger editing view.

items.question: How do I fill in custom fields on an invoice?
items.description: Fill in values for each **custom field** your business has set up, like Vehicle No or PO Number.

items.question: How do I preview an invoice PDF before saving?
items.description: Opens an in-app **PDF preview** (**Ctrl+O**) before you save or print.

items.question: How do I save an invoice?
items.description:
Click **Create/Update** (or press **Ctrl+S**) to save the invoice.

After saving, you can immediately **view**, **preview**, **download**, or **print** it.

items.question: What keyboard shortcuts work on the create invoice screen?
items.description: **Ctrl+S** save · **Ctrl+Q** new invoice · **Ctrl+F** focus product search · **Ctrl+M** add custom item · **Ctrl+O** preview PDF · **Ctrl+P** print.

items.question: What happens if I leave an invoice without saving?
items.description: If you try to leave with unsaved changes, a dialog asks whether to **keep editing**, **discard** them, or **save** first.
